name: Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JANUARY 12, 2012 - CITY HALL -
7:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION The California Court of Appeal has concluded that sectarian prayer as part of the City Council meetings is not permitted under the Constitution.
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ROLL CALL Council/Agency Member Bruce W. Barrows,
Council/Agency Member Joseph Cho, Ph.D.,
Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido,
Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Jim Edwards,
Mayor/Chair Carol Chen
5.
PRESENTATIONS:
Presentation Memo
6.
PUBLIC COMMENTS AND SUGGESTIONS
Those wishing to present comments on other than Agenda items are requested to complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card. The Public Comments and Suggestions portion of the meeting will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence for the record.
CONSENT CALENDAR
Items 7, 8, 9, and 10 under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
7.
Approval of REGISTERS OF DEMANDS
7A.
City of Cerritos dated January 12, 2012 (COUNCIL).
7B.
Cerritos Redevelopment Agency dated January 12, 2012 (AGENCY).
8.
Approval of TREASURER'S REPORT for the period ending November 30, 2011 (COUNCIL/AGENCY)
9.
Approval of MINUTES
9A.
City Council Regular Meeting of December 08, 2011 (COUNCIL).
9B.
Redevelopment Agency Regular Meeting of December 08, 2011 (AGENCY).
10.
RESOLUTIONS FOR CONSIDERATION AND ADOPTION. Reading of resolutions waived and resolutions adopted. (COUNCIL)
10A.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL FOR THE CITY OF CERRITOS PROVIDING FOR CERTAIN ADJUSTMENTS IN THE EMPLOYMENT SYSTEM AND THE PERSONNEL POLICIES, FOR ALL PART-TIME TEMPORARY EMPLOYEES, INCLUDING TEMPORARY PART-TIME EMPLOYEES REPRESENTED BY THE AMERICAN FEDERATION OF STATE, COUNTY AND MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES (AFSCME) LOCAL 619, AND REPEALING RESOLUTION NO. 2011-09 AND ALL RELATED AMENDMENTS
10B.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS MAKING A DECLARATION UNDER CALIFORNIA HEALTH AND SAFETY CODE SECTION 33354.8 THAT, DURING THE PERIOD FROM JANUARY 1, 2010, TO DECEMBER 31, 2011, THE CITY HAS NOT FORGIVEN THE REPAYMENT, WHOLLY OR PARTIALLY, OF ANY LOAN, ADVANCE, OR INDEBTEDNESS OWED TO THE CITY BY THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY (COUNCIL).
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY MAKING A DECLARATION UNDER CALIFORNIA HEALTH AND SAFETY CODE SECTION 33354.8 THAT, DURING THE PERIOD FROM JANUARY 1, 2010, TO DECEMBER 31, 2011, THE AGENCY HAS NOT FORGIVEN THE REPAYMENT, WHOLLY OR PARTIALLY, OF ANY LOAN, ADVANCE, OR INDEBTEDNESS OWED TO THE AGENCY BY A PUBLIC BODY.
END OF CONSENT CALENDAR
If you would like to speak on any of the remaining Agenda items, please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card. Speakers will be called upon for comment after the report on the item is given by City staff.
11.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
11A.
A request by applicant Jie Jiang of Njoy Spa for the approval of a Conditional Use Permit to operate a massage establishment that will offer chair massage services only. The subject property is located in a center aisle common area at 9012 Los Cerritos Mall, Cerritos, California, 90703, is zoned Regional-Commercial (CR), and is located in the Los Cerritos Redevelopment Project Area (APN 7038-014-022).
Conditional Use Permit 2011-7
Redevelopment Agency Conformity Report 2012-02
*Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt. (COUNCIL/AGENCY)
11B.
A request by applicant Avanti Business Center, LLC, 100 North Citrus Street, Suite 508, West Covina, California, 91791, for approval of a tree disposition and replacement plan for The Avanti Business Center located at 17215 and 17315 Studebaker Road, Cerritos, California, 90703. The subject property is zoned Industrial/Commercial (MC) and is located in the Los Cerritos Redevelopment Project Area (APN 7034-002-001).
Redevelopment Agency Conformity Report 2012-01 Precise Plan 80-17(B)(2011) Amendment*
*Pursuant to Section 15304 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt. (COUNCIL/AGENCY)
12.
PUBLIC WORKS ACTIVITIES
12A.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AUTHORIZING STAFF TO BYPASS THE FORMAL BIDDING PROCESS WITH EXPEDITED STREET REPAIR CONTRACTS IN SITUATIONS OF URGENT NECESSITY FOR THE PRESERVATION OF LIFE, HEALTH OR PROPERTY. (COUNCIL)
13.
NEW AND OLD BUSINESS
13A.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS DETERMINING THAT THE PUBLIC CONVENIENCE AND NECESSITY WOULD BE SERVED BY THE SUBSTITUTION OF AN EXISTING, PREVIOUSLY APPROVED OFF-SALE GENERAL LICENSE TO PERMIT THE ADDITIONAL SALE OF DISTILLED SPIRITS FOR A RETAIL SALES FACILITY, TARGET STORES #1305, LOCATED AT 11525 SOUTH STREET, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 (APN 7039-020-017). (COUNCIL)
13B.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS DETERMINING THAT THE CITY OF CERRITOS SHALL RETAIN THE HOUSING ASSETS AND FUNCTIONS OF THE DISSOLVED CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY PURSUANT TO CALIFORNIA HEALTH AND SAFETY CODE SECTION 34176.
13C.
Review and consideration of a determination of whether the City of Cerritos elects to and shall, or declines to and shall not, serve as the successor agency to the dissolved Cerritos Redevelopment Agency pursuant to California Health and Safety Code Section 34173. (COUNCIL/AGENCY)
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS DETERMINING THAT THE CITY OF CERRITOS ELECTS TO, AND SHALL, SERVE AS THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE DISSOLVED CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY PURSUANT TO CALIFORNIA HEALTH AND SAFETY CODE SECTION 34173.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS DETERMINING THAT THE CITY OF CERRITOS DECLINE TO, AND SHALL NOT, SERVE AS THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE DISSOLVED CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY PURSUANT TO CALIFORNIA HEALTH AND SAFETY CODE SECTION 34173.
14.
REPORT ON PENDING LEGISLATION
14A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
14B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor's Office for signature.
15.
CITY COUNCIL COMMUNICATIONS/COMMITTEE REPORTS/REPORT ON MEETINGS
15A.
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.
16.
ADJOURNMENT
